old = '''    # Diagonal through the outer corner diagonally opposite the L arms.
    if (horizontal, vertical) in [('bottom', 'right'), ('top', 'left')]:
        diagonal = [(r, r) for r in range(min(h, w))]
        if horizontal == 'top':
            diagonal = [(h - 1 - i, w - 1 - i) for i in range(min(h, w))]
    else:
        diagonal = [(r, w - 1 - r) for r in range(min(h, w))]
        if horizontal == 'bottom':
            diagonal = [(h - 1 - i, i) for i in range(min(h, w))]
    for r, c in diagonal:
        if (r, c) not in [diagonal[0], diagonal[-1]]:
            out[r][c] = fill
    # L translated one cell inward, without its corner.
    nvx, nhy = vx + sx, hy + sy
'''
new = '''    # L translated one cell inward, without its corner.
    nvx, nhy = vx + sx, hy + sy
    # Diagonal continuing from the translated corner away from the old corner.
    r, c = nhy + sy, nvx + sx
    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
        out[r][c] = fill
        r += sy
        c += sx
'''
assert old in program
program = program.replace(old,new)
